metadata.title: Sum vs Mean vs CAMA on Classification Tasks with Full Hyperparameters
metadata.description: Fair comparison of 3 aggregation methods (mean, sum, CAMA) on 2 RelBench classification tasks with full hyperparameters. CAMA (Cardinality-Aware Moment Aggregation) enriches mean with variance information gated by log-cardinality.
metadata.evaluation_metric: average_precision (val-based, test labels may be unavailable)

cama_vs_mean.interpretation: cama better than mean by d=5.138

cama_vs_sum.interpretation: cama better than sum by d=1.632

mean_vs_sum.interpretation: sum better than mean by d=5.499

key_findings: CAMA outperforms sum on rel-stack__user-engagement: d=1.632 (medium+ effect size)
CAMA vs mean on rel-stack__user-engagement: d=5.138
Mean vs sum on rel-stack__user-engagement: d=5.499
